summary: Frontend-only testing of two parallel additions: (1) iOS AudioUnlockOverlay splash on first session, (2) Sticker Book Teacher View toggle. All 6 review scenarios pass end-to-end on https://jelly-notes-lab.preview.emergentagent.com (1280x900). 21/21 assertions pass.

issues: Pre-existing console warning: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute'. Unrelated to current changes but worth cleaning up an with empty src somewhere in the tree.

critical_code_review_comments: useAudioUnlock.js: performUnlock() creates a throwaway AudioContext each invocation that is never .close()'d. Browsers cap context count (~6 in Chrome) — fine for one-time unlock, but consider closing it after the silent buffer plays for hygiene.

AudioUnlockOverlay uses a <motion.button> as the full-viewport overlay (good for a11y) but the inner <motion.h1>, <motion.p>, and <motion.div> with nested children render inside a <button>; this is invalid HTML (block-level descendants of button). Functionally fine but a11y/parsing concern. Consider role='button' on a <motion.div> with tabIndex=0 + keypress handling.
useAudioUnlock document-level pointerdown handler uses {once:true, capture:true}. Removal in cleanup uses {capture:true} only — that's correct match. No leak.

StickerBookPage teacherView label always reads 'Teacher View' in both states (line 217 returns the same string). Minor: could swap to 'Kid View' label when ON to make the toggle direction obvious. Current aria-pressed handles a11y but visual label is identical.
Pre-existing: console error about empty src='' attribute on an ; harmless but causes the browser to fetch the current page as an image.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audio overlay z-index:200 intercepts all clicks until dismissed. To bypass in tests: either set sessionStorage('jma_audio_unlocked_v1','1') via addInitScript BEFORE the goto, OR click the overlay first. Hash-route navigation (e.g. goto '#/x') does NOT reload the SPA, so clearing sessionStorage requires a page.reload() to reset React state. AudioContext.resume() warnings in Playwright are expected (no real user gesture) and not a bug. Verified testids: audio-unlock-overlay, teacher-view-toggle, domain-blurb-{rhythm|ear|keyboard|beat|song|scholar}, domain-teacher-desc-{...}, badge-ach_* (18 total), rank-badge, next-mission-panel, next-mission-go, bell-C.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. Initial test 3 failure was a TEST script artifact (hash-route nav doesn't reload SPA so cleared sessionStorage didn't reset React state); retest after a hard reload confirmed the auto-dismiss-on-gesture works correctly, the bell remains tappable, and bell-press produces the expected new-sticker toast.
